name: parse-error-log
description: What one node logs when its REST port receives input that is not HTTP (ergoplatform/ergo#1318): three probes on their own connections (a method longer than 16 characters starting with ESC, a short unknown method of bytes 0x80-0x82, a TLS-style start as the control), each HTTP status, and the 'Illegal request' lines the console log gains. pass = every probe logged a line, no line carries a detail after the summary or a byte outside printable ASCII, and /info still answers. Base (akka's default full verbosity): the detail and the request bytes are logged, pass false; candidate with error-logging-verbosity = simple: pass true.
